lines.zh: 我摆着厚鳍，慢慢往前游。
lines.en: I swing my thick fins and swim slowly.
My scales are hard as armor.
I glide slowly along the reef's back.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴一次只推一下。
lines.en: My tail gives one slow push at a time.
It's deep here, with little light.

lines.zh: 我抬起身子，绕过一道缝隙。
lines.en: I lift myself through a gap.
I glide through the water layer.
My fins move like stubby legs.
I drift with the current.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚的影子里穿过。
lines.en: I pass through the coral's shadow.
I stop and hang there.
I turn slowly toward the deeper water.

lines.zh: 我从两丛海草之间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass between two clumps of weed.
My shadow falls on the sandy floor.
I head for a warmer layer.
I let the current carry me.

lines.zh: 我在礁石背面停了一会。
lines.en: I pause behind the reef.
I cruise slowly over the sandy floor.
I wait for the current to change on its own.
Water slides over my thick scales.

lines.zh: 我悬在礁石边，不太游动。
lines.en: I hang by the reef, barely swimming.
This warm current is pleasant.
Water slips past my gills.
I'm in no hurry to eat.

lines.zh: 我像是从很久以前留下来的。
lines.en: I feel like something left over from long ago.
My fins twitch now and then.
The light is faint here.
The water pushes. I sweep my tail slowly.
Small fish pass the reef.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼从礁边过，我连身都没转。
lines.en: A school passes the reef. I don't even turn.
I brace against the reef with a fin.
Sand under me. The bottom is quiet.
I stop before you.
Your shadow covers the whole reef.
I fan my fins and back into the reef gap.
Your shadow fills the water.
I turn on my side by the reef.

lines.zh: 我侧过身子打量你，你却纹丝不动。
lines.en: I tilt to size you up. You don't stir.

lines.zh: 我停住端详你，鳍一直撑着。
lines.en: I stop and study you, fins spread.
You don't move. I wait a while.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子转过来。
lines.en: I swing around along your shadow.
Then I return to the reef.
Struck, I roll onto my side.
A scale chips off.

lines.zh: 我拼命拍鳍，想把身子摆正。
lines.en: I beat my fins to right myself.
The pain presses me to the reef.
I push into the reef crevice.
One tailbeat and I slip aside.
The pale marks show on my scales.

lines.zh: 鳞上都是白痕，我还能游。
lines.en: Pale marks on my scales, but I can still swim.

lines.zh: 鳞上都是白痕，这一下很疼。
lines.en: Pale marks all over my scales. That hurt.
My blood draws out in threads.
Specks drift at this depth.

lines.zh: 你撒下去的那些，我瞧见了。
lines.en: I saw what you scattered.
I drift closer to the scraps.

lines.zh: 我摆着厚鳍靠近，把嘴张开了。
lines.en: I swing my thick fins close and open my mouth.
One filtered mouthful. The taste is faint.
I filter a mouthful, then another.
Not enough. I take another bite.
I turn back toward the scraps.

lines.zh: 我掉头游回来，还想要一点。
lines.en: I turn back. I'd like a little more.
I stop by the reef and wait.
My scales scrape stone; I steady myself.
I flap my fins to steady.
A pale mark is scraped on my scales.
The bump drops me half a foot.
Your strength is too much.

lines.zh: 这一下力道过头，我摆鳍退开。
lines.en: Too much force. I fin my way off.
Behind the reef, I stop.
Behind the reef, I look back again.
I look back. You haven't followed.

lines.zh: 背后空空的，我才放下心。
lines.en: Nothing follows. I relax.
A kin's scent in the water.
We drift closer.
Its scales are brighter than mine.
We swim abreast a good while.
It heads deeper first.

lines.zh: 它一头扎向深处，我跟在后头。
lines.en: It dives deep. I follow behind.

lines.zh: 水里有细小的东西在漂。
lines.en: Tiny things drift in the water.
I spread my fins as wide as they go.
This patch of sea is old enough.

lines.zh: 这片水域年头够久，我就守着。
lines.en: This water is old enough. I'll stay.
I open my mouth and draw it in.

lines.zh: 小得连一丝触感都没有。
lines.en: So small I feel nothing.
Too small. I spit it out.
Wrong taste. Not food.
I pin it with a pectoral fin.

lines.zh: 我松了口，那东西往下坠。
lines.en: I let go and it sinks.
I don't follow it down.
I don't chase. I go back to hovering.
It sinks and the water quiets.
Nothing in my mouth can be swallowed.

lines.zh: 那边的水纹有些不对劲。
lines.en: The ripples over there look wrong.
I feel the water shift and stop.
I see it clearly. That's not a fish.
I swing my thick fins around.

lines.zh: 我缓缓转身，两边的鳍全撑开。
lines.en: I turn slowly, fins spreading wide.
I edge toward the reef.

lines.zh: 我朝礁背退，那影子压得吓人。
lines.en: I back toward the reef. The shadow is huge.
The shadow is large. I sink.
I sink. It doesn't follow.
I'm below. I wait for it to go.
I waited. It's still overhead.
I hold against the reef.

lines.zh: 我的鳞和石头一个颜色。
lines.en: My scales match the stone.

lines.zh: 鳞和石头一个颜色，它游过去了。
lines.en: My scales match the stone. It swims past.

lines.zh: 它一过去，我就候水流转向。
lines.en: Once it passes, I wait for the turn.
The current passes. The water stills.
The water stills, and I rise.
I rise and look. The surface is empty.
I return to the warm current.

lines.zh: 我游回暖流，尾巴一下一下推。
lines.en: Back in the warm current, my tail pushes slowly.
I lash my tail across.
That force is like a push of water.
I bump and withdraw.
My fin slaps against it.

lines.zh: 触腕拍在它身上，我力气很小。
lines.en: My fin slaps it. I'm not strong.
I swim back to the reef.
The impact hurt a little.

lines.zh: 我匆匆退回礁边，挤进缝隙。
lines.en: I hurry back to the reef and wedge in.
In the crevice, it can't reach me.

lines.zh: 它伸不到这儿，我缓缓换气。
lines.en: It can't reach here. I breathe slow.
I appear in the warm current.
My scales catch the faint light.
This sea is heavy with quiet.
I rise slowly into the warm layer.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，身体很沉。
lines.en: I sweep my tail once. My body is heavy.
I swim toward the reef.
There are crevices to hide in.
I slip halfway in.

lines.zh: 半个身子在缝里，脑袋露在外。
lines.en: Half inside, my head still out.
Only my head out. The water is warm.

lines.zh: 水变烫了，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats and I dive deep.
I hit the surface and roll.

lines.zh: 明明泡在水里，我却憋闷。
lines.en: In the water, and yet I’m stifling.

lines.zh: 水下的闷响把我推出去。
lines.en: The underwater blast shoves me away.

lines.zh: 一支箭射进水里，划破我的鳞。
lines.en: An arrow enters the water and splits my scales.
Light locks the water and I can't move.
Too hungry to move my fins.

lines.zh: 电流顺水爬满全身，我僵住。
lines.en: Current crawls through the water; I lock up.

lines.zh: 水一下子不见，我往黑里沉。
lines.en: The water is gone. I sink into black.
